```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
```

## Union station

```{r data}
data <- read.csv('./weighted_refactored_income.csv')
nona <-  na.omit(data)
head(nona)
```

```{r linmod1}

linmod <- lm(data=nona, shortest_path ~ income^2)

summary(linmod)
```

```{r linmod2}
linmod <- lm(data=nona, n_cameras ~ shortest_path + 0) 

summary(linmod)
```

```{r linmod3}
linmod <- lm(data=data, n_cameras ~ poly(income, 2, raw=TRUE)) 

summary(linmod)
```
